description: Multi-step polars LazyFrame pipeline in a single Dagster asset (query-plan fusion across all steps).

inputs.description: Upstream DataFrame(s) — one or more, depending on shape

outputs.description: Polars or pandas DataFrame after the chain (last step / primary_step)

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Flat shape (one source, one ops chain, one sink)

operations.label: Operations
operations.description: Flat shape: ordered list of polars ops applied to upstream_asset_key. Supported: filter, with_columns, select, drop, group_by, sort, head/limit, tail, head_per_group, unique, drop_nulls, fill_null, cast, join, sql.

steps.label: Steps
steps.description: Multi-step form. Each step: {id, source: {kind: upstream|ref, upstream_asset_key|ref}, operations: [...]}. Use 'op: sql' to drop into polars SQLContext (current chain = 'self'; prior steps usable by id).

sinks.label: Sinks
sinks.description: Optional side-output writes. Each: {from: <step_id>, kind: parquet|csv, path: '...'}. These run after the chain finishes; the asset's return value comes from primary_step.

primary_step.label: Primary Step
primary_step.description: Step id whose frame is the asset's return value (default: last step)

streaming.description: Use polars streaming engine for the final collect.
streaming.label: Streaming

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include a preview of the output data in metadata (sample rows) for builder UIs.

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata when `include_preview_metadata` is True.

source.label: Source
source.description: File / URL source shape. `{kind: file, path, format?, delimiter?}` or `{kind: url, url, format?, delimiter?}` or `{kind: upstream_asset, upstream_asset_key}`. `path`/`url` support `{partition_key}` and `{partition.<name>}` templating. Format is inferred from extension (.json / .ndjson / .csv / .parquet / .ipc / .avro) when unset. Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values (e.g. customers); 'multi' for date × static (e.g. day × customer). Leave empty for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start Date

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

metadata.label: Metadata
metadata.description: Asset-level metadata dict — passed straight through to `@asset(metadata=...)`. Useful for keys the IO manager reads at handle_output time (e.g. `{partition_expr: created_at}` for `DuckDBPolarsIOManagerComponent`, or `{dagster/column_schema: <schema>}` for a hand-authored schema). Kept separate from `asset_tags` — tags are for catalog filtering, metadata is arbitrary key-value data consumed by tooling.

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition. 0 (the Dagster default) means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows -- e.g. a daily set never includes today until tomorrow. Set to 1 to include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset, matching Dagster's own default).

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' materializes an entire backfill range in one run -- the partition_key token threaded through this pipeline's step templating (file/url paths, table names) becomes a comma-joined string spanning the whole range. 'multi_run' launches one run per partition. Leave empty for Dagster's default (one run per partition, uncapped). Ignored when Partition Type is not set. 'single_run' requires a partition-range-aware IO manager (e.g. a DB-table IO manager with partition_expr set) -- a generic filesystem/default IO manager cannot persist a single_run output spanning multiple partitions and will raise a clear error at materialization time.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For Backfill Policy = 'multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave empty for Dagster's default (1).
